item.title: Strategic Acquisition in the Field of Uncrewed and Autonomous Systems: Rheinmetall to Gain Majority Stake in DOK-ING
item.description: The Düsseldorf-based technology group Rheinmetall is expanding its portfolio with an acquisition in the field of uncrewed systems. Rheinmetall has now signed a contract in Zagreb to buy a majority stake of Croatian uncrewed ground system solution provider DOK-ING. item.title: British Paratroopers Fight on the electromagnetic Spectrum
item.description: To survive on the modern battlefield, paratroopers are adapting to fight the unseen battle on the radio waves.
